extras: The plugin drastically alters default Obsidian behavior and creates a large number of files (one for every conjugation of every word).
problem: Manually creating and linking vocabulary entries and grammatical forms from reading German texts is time-consuming.

relations.evidence: Used to segment and classify text.
Used to write dictionary entries and translations.

summary: A language learning tool that uses AI to generate structured dictionary entries and manage vocabulary links based on German texts.
